owner_cycle_justifications.justification: These exact owners form the live mutual bridge between canonical durable aggregation and the feature oracles that consume durable facts and projections, then publish decisions and outcomes back into that canonical aggregation path. This records the current SCC rather than permitting new dependencies: exact membership must shrink on cutover, and any removed bridge edge makes the declaration stale.
